description:
The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A medical illustrator needs a 3D model of ONLY the Patient's Left Hemicranium (the left half of the skull) for a cutaway visualization. 

Your goal is to:
1. Create a bone segmentation mask (using a standard bone threshold, e.g., 226 HU).
2. Use the mask editing/crop tools to remove the Patient's Right side of the skull, cutting along the mid-sagittal plane.
3. Generate a 3D surface from this cropped mask.
4. Export the resulting surface as a binary STL file to `/home/ga/Documents/left_hemicranium.stl`.

Note: Pay attention to the 'R' (Right) and 'L' (Left) orientation markers in the slice views to ensure you keep the correct side.
